==Cycle of Samsara==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is able to cycle between three different modes: '''Normal Mode''', '''Bleed Mode''' and '''Hybrid Mode'''.
<br>
<tabber>
|-|Normal Mode=<br>'''{{PAGENAME}}''' attacks with a '''Staff''' with a small circle AoE. While in this mode, {{PAGENAME}} has a single hit attack with low SPA.

|-|Bleed Mode=<br>'''{{PAGENAME}}''' attacks with a '''Scythe''' with a large circle AoE. While in this mode, {{PAGENAME}} has a single hit attack with 1.5 times longer SPA than Normal Mode. '''{{PAGENAME}} will inflict bleed equal to 30% of his damage over 3 ticks'''.<br><br>

''In Bleed Mode, he has '''13.33% less average DPS''' than normal mode. However with bleed amplification (x5 bleed dmg), '''he has 66.66% more average DPS'''.''

|-|Hybrid Mode=<br>'''{{PAGENAME}}''' attacks with a '''Halberd''' with a line AoE. While in this mode, {{PAGENAME}} has a single hit attack with 1.5 times more damage, 2 times longer SPA, and 1.5 times more range than Normal Mode. '''{{PAGENAME}} becomes hybrid, gaining the ability to attack flying enemies'''.<br><br>

''In Hybrid Mode he has '''25% less average DPS''' than normal mode.''
</tabber>
